facts.business: Consolidated Finvest & Holdings Limited is an RBI-registered non-deposit taking Middle Layer NBFC engaged in lending and investment mainly in group companies.

segments.name: Lending and Investment in Group Companies

key_risks: Performance risk of group companies where strategic investments are held
Market risk from investments in mutual funds
facts.related_party_note: Company makes long term strategic investments in various new ventures promoted by Group, besides consolidating existing investments through further investments in existing companies.
